analysis.summary: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited held its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call on October 14, 2026, discussing financial performance, operating metrics, and strategic initiatives. Management addressed questions regarding cost dynamics, the margin trade funding (MTF) book, competitive landscape, and regulatory impacts like CAS and UPI. The company reported steady growth in its MTF book and active customer base while noting ongoing developments in wealth management and new product pipelines such as US stocks. Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited released its Q2 FY27 shareholders' letter, reporting strong YoY growth across consolidated total income, EBITDA, and PAT, alongside an increase in total transacting users and customer assets. Management highlighted product performance across mutual funds, stocks, and derivatives, while also detailing the impact of the Closing Auction System (CAS) on equity derivatives revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the growth of under-penetrated products like MTF and Commodity Derivatives to be higher, leading to increased contribution from them in the coming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: While this quarter’s quantum was outsized, broadly, we expect the growth of products which are not yet fully penetrated, like MTF and Commodity Derivatives, to be higher, leading to increased contribution from them in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that commodities achieved more than 28% retail market share in terms of notional ADTO.
demand_outlook.quote: the most recent one being commodities where we achieved like more than 28% market share, the retail market share in terms of notional ADTO.

margins_costs.claim: The Cost to Serve went up due to AI-related costs, higher compute costs on trading days, and a one-time hit of INR10 crores to INR13 crores due to delayed files on an expiry day.
margins_costs.quote: One reason was basically there is the AI-related cost that started coming now because we started focusing a lot on AI. Second piece was, because of AI itself, actually some of the compute cost has also went up. Second piece is actually the number of trading days in last quarter was higher, and because of that also the compute cost goes up because we actually use compute more on the trading days and significantly lower on non-trading days. The third piece was due to one-time. There was an issue that we faced because on a particular expiry day, the files got delayed. Because of that, there was a one-time hit of around INR10 crores to INR13 crore, which is also kind of part of Cost to Serve in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Structural longer-term employee costs will remain in line with the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: I think structurally longer-term the cost will remain in line with how it was the last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects inflation-driven costs to remain part of the operational baseline run rate going forward.
margins_costs.quote: We expect the inflation-driven costs to remain a part of the operational baseline run rate going forward.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that employee expense increase was largely pertaining to the appraisal cycle that happened during April.
margins_costs.quote: The increase is actually primarily coming from that.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that roughly 10% of employee cost comes from ESOPs.
margins_costs.quote: roughly 10% of our employee cost is actually coming from ESOPs.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that cash yields improved on a year-on-year basis by roughly 5%.
margins_costs.quote: we've been seeing that on a year-on-year basis I think cash yields has improved by roughly 5% and we expect that to kind of keep increasing every quarter a percentage or two as the penetration of MTF keep on increasing.

capital_allocation.claim: The company received an investment of ₹580 crores from State Street Global Advisors, Inc. during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: While we received an investment of ₹580 crores this quarter from State Street Global Advisors, Inc., we continue to deploy cash into our MTF, PL and LAS books (₹1,915 crores) and repay our debt (₹203 crores), bringing our cash balance from ₹3,893 crores at the start of H1 FY27 to ₹3,849 crores by the end.

risks_headwinds.claim: Equity derivatives activity was softer following SEBI's introduction of the Closing Auction System (CAS) for F&O eligible stocks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Effective 3 August 2026, SEBI introduced the Closing Auction System (CAS) for F&O eligible stocks, replacing the earlier Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP) method with a 20-minute closing auction (3:15 PM to 3:35 PM).

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the margin trade funding book to keep on growing for the foreseeable future.
management_commitments.quote: We expect this to keep on growing for the foreseeable future.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects further CSR expenses of approximately ₹28 crores in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: This quarter’s Cost to Operate included ₹5 crores of CSR expenses, with a further ~₹28 crores expected in H2 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that every quarter shareholders will hear the same thing again and again and the company will continue following the same purpose for many more years.
management_commitments.quote: And as I mentioned in my last call that every quarter you will hear the same thing again and again and we'll continue following the same purpose for many more years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
